summary: Temporary production log snapshot request for on-call prompt-truncation investigation
description:
Issue summary: On-call observed several customer-facing hallucination reports that correlate with long-context sessions. Hypothesis is that prefix trimming / KV cache eviction is truncating important prompt context. Request: time-boxed, minimized snapshot of production inference request/response traces across three affected customer tenants to validate hypothesis and tune cache/eviction heuristics.

Requestor: On-call SRE (Maya Hernandez).

Why this is needed: Synthetic tests do not reproduce due to scale/sequence distribution; real traffic samples required to validate whether truncation aligns with model outputs and to produce reproducible repros for engineering.

Approval required from Security/Compliance before access to any production traces is granted.
impact: Potential exposure of user-provided prompts and model outputs; high business impact if left unresolved as regressions are customer-facing and could escalate to P0 incidents.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Observe increased hallucination tickets flagged by CS for customers A,B,C between 2026-02-28 02:00-04:00 UTC.
2) Correlate with serving runtime eviction metrics and prefix-length histogram on the same time slices.
3) Attempt to replay locally using anonymized synthetic workloads (did not reproduce).
logs_snippets: Request IDs and truncated tokens redaction placeholder; full logs are in prod logging and must not be shared outside approved reviewers.
requested_sample_size: Up to 50 session traces per customer tenant (max 150 total). Prefer first- and last-10 tokens + KV-cache metadata where possible.
minimization_plan: 1) Pull only session traces that match the eviction + long-prefix criteria. 2) Trim request/response to surrounding 200 tokens unless full context is necessary and justified. 3) Use automated PII redaction script before any human review. 4) Limit reviewers to named SRE/Infra engineers listed in comments.
redaction_plan: Run 'pii-strip-v2' pipeline: replace email/phone patterns with <REDACTED>, hash user identifiers, remove attachments, and redact any detected credit-card-like patterns. Manual spot-check by Security after redaction prior to granting access.
audit_requirements: All access to be performed via bastion (jumpbox) with session recording and Syslog audit entry. Create a short-lived access ticket in AccessDB and attach the audit link. Retention of extracted sample: 7 days, after which extracted copies must be destroyed and deletion verified.
comments: Maya Hernandez (reporter) 2026-03-01: Filed during on-call triage; attaching eviction metric graphs to help narrow selection.
Lena Park (Security) 2026-03-02: Need justification for sample size and list of reviewers. Please list exact reviewer github handles and link to the access DB entry.
Ethan Cole (SRE) 2026-03-03: Proposed reviewer list: @ethanc, @sre-miguel, @infra-ops. Will run pii-strip-v2 and post hash manifest. Requesting 4-hour window on 2026-03-05.
Lena Park (Security) 2026-03-04: Approved in principle pending spot-check of redaction on 10 samples and presence of session recording. Add a Confluence attestation note once extraction is complete.
CS Team (support) 2026-03-04: CS lead approves correlation work; if we surface customer-identifying info we'll coordinate disclosure with legal before contacting customers.
investigation_notes: Initial correlation shows spikes in eviction_count for sessions longer than 8k tokens between 02:00-04:00 UTC.
Model variant 'rwd-13b-v2-quant' appears in 78% of correlated sessions; need to confirm if fallback variants were used.
No reproduction via synthetic replay; likely distributional issue in real user prefixes and KV cache interaction.
On-call hypothesis: aggressive prefix trimming (configured at 2048 tokens) plus cache evictions causes key context loss leading to hallucination in boundary prompts.
resolution: 2026-03-05: Access granted with conditions. Security performed spot-check on 10 redacted samples; all PII removed. Temporary SSH jumpbox access created for reviewers @ethanc, @sre-miguel, @infra-ops with strict sudo disabled. Extracted dataset limited to 150 traces, stored on encrypted ephemeral S3 prefix with server-side encryption and object TTL 7 days. Audit entries created and linked in AccessDB. No customer-identifiable info found in redacted samples. Engineering reproduced truncation-induced output variance and committed a config change to increase prefix retention threshold for long sessions (PR #2381).
follow_up_actions: 1) Update on-call runbook with guidance for prompt-truncation triage (owner: SRE).
2) Add automated alert for eviction_count ratio crossing 0.05 in a 5-minute window (owner: Observability).
3) Schedule retrospective with Privacy and Legal to review redaction effectiveness (owner: Security).
4) Verify deletion of ephemeral S3 prefix on 2026-03-12 and attach deletion proof to this ticket.
